# waffles development.

## Overview
Personal portfolio website for wafflez (also known as ilykeelon), a Minecraft Network Manager with 7+ years of experience specializing in server setups, plugin configuration, Velocity proxies, custom Skript systems, and server optimization.

## Project Structure
- `index.html` - Main single-page application with multiple sections (Home, About, Work, Plugins, Credits, FAQ, Privacy)
- `404.html` - Custom 404 error page
- `sitemap.xml` - XML sitemap for SEO
- `images/` - Directory for image assets
- `music/` - Directory for music files used in the embedded music player

## Technology Stack
- HTML5 (single-page application)
- CSS3 (custom variables, responsive design, dark theme)
- Vanilla JavaScript (no frameworks)
- Font Awesome 6.5.0 (icons)
- Google Fonts (Poppins, DM Sans, Fraunces, Figtree)
- Lenis (smooth scrolling)
- Anime.js 3.2.1 (animations)
- jsmediatags (ID3 tag reading for music metadata)

## Key Features
- Single-page application with client-side routing and per-page meta titles/descriptions
- Fixed dark theme
- Embedded music player with audio visualization
- Responsive design (mobile, tablet, desktop)
- SEO optimized with meta tags, canonical URLs, Open Graph, and sitemap
- Accessibility features (ARIA labels, skip link, focus-visible styles, reduced-motion support, semantic HTML)
- Cookie consent notice (local storage only, no tracking)
- FAQ and Privacy Policy pages

## Navigation Sections
1. **Home** - Hero section, server types, skills overview
2. **About** - Personal information, plugin expertise, background
3. **Work** - Service pricing, past work examples, client reviews
4. **Plugins** - Premium downloadable resources (BuiltByBit integration)
5. **Credits** - Tools and libraries used to build the site
6. **FAQ** - Common questions about services and ordering
7. **Privacy** - Privacy policy (no tracking, no data collection)

## Deployment
This site is hosted on GitHub Pages at https://xwqfflez.github.io/

## Development Notes
- The site uses client-side JavaScript for page navigation (no actual page reloads)
- Music player uses Web Audio API for visualization
- Cookie consent choice is saved to localStorage (the only stored data)
- Images are hosted on external services (postimg.cc, discordapp.com, cdn.simpleicons.org)
